name: UENI
summary: A done-for-you small-business website, built for you rather than a builder you have to learn: a one-time build fee plus a monthly plan that includes domain, email and a launch call. DIY editing is limited and the seven-day promise often slips.
best_for: small-business owners with no time or tech skills who want a professional site built for them, not another tool to learn
skip_if: you want full control over design, run a real e-commerce store, or need deep customisation and integrations: a DIY builder gives you more freedom
honest_knock: It's done-for-you, which is the appeal and the catch. DIY editing and customisation are limited, e-commerce and integrations are basic, and the most common complaint is the gap between the 7-day promise and reality: slow design turnaround and patchy communication with the team. Expect some upselling.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-11-18 on ueni.com/en-us/pricing and ueni.com/llms.txt; the separate Ecommerce tier recorded on 2026-09-09 and 2026-09-26 is no longer offered) A done-for-you website, now sold in three tiers. Every tier carries the same setup fee of $599, currently promoted at $79 (the page banner reads 'EARLY BLACK FRIDAY' and 'SAVE $520'). Launch is $24.99/mo and covers a custom-designed site, domain and SSL, hosting, one professional email address and 30 days of done-for-you edits. Plus is $59.00/mo and adds unlimited done-for-you edits, four email addresses, advanced SEO, Google Business Profile setup and management, calendar-synced online bookings, online payments for services, integrations such as live chat and lead forms, promotion on Google, Facebook and Instagram, and VIP phone support. Growth is $124.99/mo and adds a dedicated VIP Growth Team, a custom marketing plan, monthly one-on-one sessions, marketing across email, social, ads, SEO and reputation, and 2,000 words of fresh content a month. In the comparison table a basic shopping cart is ticked on all three tiers, while the full online store, abandoned cart recovery, product subscriptions, advanced bookings and deposits, and loyalty and reviews are ticked only on Growth. The yearly toggle ('Save ~17%') shows $20.83 a month ($249.90 billed annually) on Launch, $49.17 ($590) on Plus and $104.16 ($1,249.90) on Growth, which checks out at about 17% against twelve monthly payments. The two-year toggle says 'Save ~34%' and shows $18.74 ($449.82), $44.25 ($1,062) and $93.74 ($2,249.82); against twenty-four monthly payments ($599.76, $1,416 and $2,999.76) that is 25% off on every tier, not 34%. Transaction fees are 0% on every tier and there is a 30-day money-back guarantee.
